title: 12 Best Food Halls in Almaty
description: Discover the top food halls in Almaty, Kazakhstan for 2026. From modern gastronomic centers to traditional bazaars, find the best spots for local and international cuisine.

places.name: Bazaar Almaty (Гастро-базар Алматы)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the Korean-style fried chicken from one of the vendors, paired with a craft beer or unique cocktail from the central bar.

places.name: Dostyk Plaza Food Hall (Food Street)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample the noodle dishes from one of the pan-Asian stalls or grab a premium burger from a local fast-casual spot.

places.name: Green Bazaar (Zelyony Bazaar) Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Don't miss the freshly made laghman (hand-pulled noodles), samsa (savory pastries baked in a tandoor), or a plate of plov (rice pilaf).

places.name: Esentai Gallery Food Area (Esentai Mall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy fresh sushi or a gourmet sandwich from one of the boutique eateries, followed by a specialty coffee.

places.name: Forum Almaty Food Street / Gastro Corner
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the authentic Italian pizza from one of the pizzerias or a hearty bowl from a Vietnamese pho joint.

places.name: Orda Bazaar (Food Section)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for fresh tandyr bread and shashlik (grilled skewers), a Central Asian staple.

places.name: Mega Center Alma-Ata Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for a classic Doner Kebab or explore the local dumpling (manti) options available from specific stalls.

places.name: Mega Park Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the pilaf or laghman from a local vendor, or stick to familiar comfort food from an international chain.

places.name: Aport Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a large portion of doner kebab or a classic Russian borscht if available from one of the local stalls.

places.name: Zhibek Zholy Street Food (near Arbat)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try corn on the cob, a fresh fruit smoothie, or one of the many Korean-influenced street foods like Tteokbokki.

places.name: Gorky Park Food Zone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly grilled shashlik (meat skewer) is a must-try, along with a cold drink or local ice cream.

places.name: Altyn-Orda Market (Food Section)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Be adventurous and try different kinds of homemade samsa, traditional soups like shorpa, or various grilled meats.
